commands:
set -eu
sudo docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
for task_path in /home/ubuntu/everyday /home/ec2-user/everyday; do
 if [ -d "$task_path" ]; then
  printf 'Deployment directory: %s\n' "$task_path"
  for task_file in compose.aws.yaml .env.aws; do
   if [ -f "$task_path/$task_file" ]; then printf '%s exists\n' "$task_file"; else printf '%s missing\n' "$task_file"; fi
  done
 fi
done
curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w 'Frontend local HTTP status: %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1/healthz
